dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin now over 12 cents, thanks to Coinbase (somehow?) or @page88 (somehow?) or, you know, just, it’s 2021. 

Question: How much does it cost to mine 1 dogecoin? Last time I looked I think it was about 5 cents? Is this really a free-money arb right now?

@KidDynamiteBlog If a company paid you $1000 a year ago, you paid tax on $1000 you earned. If you then spent that money on Dogecoin and it’s now worth $100,000, and you take all those profits, it’s a bit weird to say “I shouldn’t pay tax on the $100k because I paid tax on the $1k”.
Crypto pitch du jour: A “stablecoin backed by Dogecoin"
